title: VinUniversity and Let’s Do It Vietnam Collecting Over 40 Tons of Waste on World Cleanup Day 2025
summary: On the morning of October 11, 2025, the VinUniversity Sustainability Committee, in collaboration with the Let’s Do It Vietnam, successfully hosted World Cleanup Day 2025 in Gia Lam Ward.

contentBlocks.value: On the morning of October 11, 2025, the VinUniversity Sustainability Committee, in collaboration with the Let’s Do It Vietnam, successfully hosted World Cleanup Day 2025 in Gia Lam Ward.

More than 100 students, faculty, staff, and community members came together with one mission: to make a difference. In just a few hours, they collected over 40.3 tons of waste, from construction debris to recyclable and non-recyclable inorganic materials, helping restore the beauty of the area and raise awareness about environmental protection.
